Kancor Ingredients Limited.note: French flavour and fragrance firm MANE acquired a majority stake in 2014 and later fully rebranded it as Mane Kancor Ingredients Private Limited.

Lotus Corporate Private Limited.note: Lotus Corporate Private Limited is not verified to have been acquired by another company, and its premium spices and seasonings brand, SNAP!N, continues to operate under Duval Enterprises Private Limited.

PKM Foods Private Limited.note: PKM Foods Private Limited is a family-owned spice manufacturing business based in Pune that operates the Prakash Masale brand.

Rajani Masala Co.note: Rajani Masala Co operates under the family-owned Rajani Group, producing tea, spices, and other FMCG goods since 1975.

Sakthi Masala Private Limited.note: Sakthi Masala Private Limited remains a 100% family-owned enterprise managed by its original founders.

Shyam Masala Udyog.note: Shyam Masala Udyog operates independently as an ISO certified spice manufacturer based in Chhattisgarh.

Suraj Chhap Masala.note: Suraj Chhap Masala operates as an independent traditional spice brand serving Indian kitchens.

The Peninsular Export Company.note: The Peninsular Export Company runs independently as part of the century-old, family-owned VPSA Paramasiva Nadar group.
